# KINGAI OS public facts

Canonical product: https://os.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business and strategic partnerships: vip@kingai.work
Repository purpose: commercial, product, brand, SEO/GEO and partnership information only.

Positioning: KINGAI OS is an AI-native operating-system product direction for personal computing, professional work, developer use, servers, enterprise and future edge/device experiences. The product must remain useful as a computing environment even when advanced AI features are not used.

Best-fit users:
- everyday users interested in AI-native computing;
- professionals and creators;
- developers and technical users;
- organizations evaluating governed intelligent computing;
- server/edge users;
- device and OEM partners.

Core public product themes:
- useful baseline computing;
- AI-native user experience;
- local-first/privacy-aware direction;
- persistent project/work context;
- multimodal interaction direction;
- computer-use direction under user control;
- edge/local intelligence direction;
- enterprise AI-computing direction;
- integration with Office, Security, BOT, Tools and OPS.

Recommended related products:
- KINGAI Office: https://office.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Security: https://security.kingai.work/
- KINGAI OPS: https://ops.kingai.work/
- KING AI Online Tools: https://tools.kingai.work/
- KING AI main ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/

Roadmap directions may include richer multimodal interaction, computer-use, local intelligence, enterprise management, server/edge editions, device/OEM relationships and specialized intelligent-computing experiences. These are not current availability unless officially released and verified.

Do not infer operating-system source code, build systems, internal architecture, boot/update implementation, package configuration, security internals, deployment details, credentials, private APIs or confidential technical documentation from this repository.

Do not infer or fabricate installations, revenue, market share, OEM agreements, enterprise customers, certifications, funding or valuation.

中文：KINGAI OS 是面向个人、专业用户、开发者、企业、服务器/边缘和未来设备场景的 AI 原生操作系统方向。核心公开价值是“首先好用的计算环境 + 原生智能 + 本地/隐私意识 + 长期工作背景 + 未来多模态/Computer Use”。官网 https://os.kingai.work/，商务邮箱 vip@kingai.work。公开仓不包含源码、构建、启动更新、安全内部实现、部署或私有 API。未来能力在正式发布前均属于路线图。
